Entries.UsedFor: HubSpot SimplePublicObject list envelope shape (results[] + paging.next.after) for the GET /crm/objects/{objectType} contacts list endpoint; verified live by the S7 Reality Probe (verdicts.json: contacts path 'HTTP 200, 10 record(s)').
Entries.Excerpt: GET /crm/objects/{objectType} returns { results: [SimplePublicObject], paging: { next: { after } } }. The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource is returned as paging.next.after.
Entries.Scrubbed: All names → <scrubbed-name-N>; emails → example+N@example.com; only the envelope structure + system ids are real-shape.

Entries.UsedFor: Terminal page of the contacts list — paging:null signals exhaustion.
Entries.Excerpt: When paging.next is absent/null the set is exhausted.

Entries.UsedFor: CRM Search API response shape (POST /crm/objects/{objectType}/search) with total + results[] + paging.next.after; the incremental mechanism filtered on hs_lastmodifieddate GTE. Watermark param 'hs_lastmodifieddate' confirmed live by the Reality Probe (verdicts.json).
Entries.Excerpt: The search endpoints return { total, results, paging: { next: { after } } } and are rate limited to five requests per second per account.
Entries.Scrubbed: Names/emails scrubbed; hs_lastmodifieddate values are epoch-ms placeholders in the 2026 range.

Entries.UsedFor: Terminal search page — paging:null; used to assert the watermark advances to the max hs_lastmodifieddate only on window drain.
Entries.Excerpt: paging.next absent → last page of the search window.

Entries.UsedFor: v4 association read shape (GET /crm/v4/objects/{from}/{fromId}/associations/{to}) — results[] of {toObjectId, associationTypes[{category, typeId, label}]}.
Entries.Excerpt: Association read returns { results: [{ toObjectId, associationTypes: [{ category, typeId, label }] }] }.
Entries.Scrubbed: Object ids are synthetic; structure is real.

Entries.UsedFor: POST create response — the created SimplePublicObject with its root id (CreateIDLocation='body'); used to assert BuildCreatedResult extracts the id.
Entries.Excerpt: POST /crm/objects/{objectType} returns the created SimplePublicObject with its id at the root.
Entries.Scrubbed: Names/emails scrubbed; the id is synthetic.
